name: AWR (Advantage-Weighted Regression)
tagline: Replace PPO's clipped surrogate with supervised regression of the policy on actions reweighted by exponentiated advantages.
diff_from_baseline: Peng et al., 'Advantage-Weighted Regression: Simple and Scalable Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning' (2019). Treats policy improvement as supervised regression on advantage-weighted actions.

name: PPO (clipped surrogate)
tagline: Standard PPO clipped surrogate plus clipped value-loss; the cleanrl on-policy continuous-control reference.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman et al., 'Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms' (2017); cleanrl/ppo_continuous_action.py reference. Default on-policy continuous-control baseline.

name: PPO (Adaptive KL Penalty)
tagline: Replace ratio clipping with an adaptive-coefficient KL penalty: doubles when KL exceeds 1.5x target, halves when below 1/1.5x target.
pseudocode:
1. Init $\beta=0.5$, $\mathrm{KL}^*=0.01$.
2. Each minibatch: compute $r_t = \exp(\log\pi_\theta-\log\pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}})$ and $\widehat{\mathrm{KL}} = \mathbb{E}[(r_t-1)-\log r_t]$.
3. Loss = $-\mathbb{E}[r_t A_t] + \beta\,\widehat{\mathrm{KL}}$.
4. Adapt $\beta$: if $\widehat{\mathrm{KL}} > 1.5\,\mathrm{KL}^*$ then $\beta\mathrel{*}=2$ (cap 100); if $\widehat{\mathrm{KL}} < \mathrm{KL}^*/1.5$ then $\beta\mathrel{/}=2$ (floor 1e-4).
5. Add MSE value loss + entropy bonus.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman et al., 'Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms' (2017), Section 4. PPO-Penalty variant with adaptive KL coefficient instead of clipping.
